title: Budget the Retrieval
tagline: The cap counts queries, and a run that reaches the cap is a normal outcome, not an error.

story.problem: An unbounded search loop lets a scout spend hours and a full budget and find nothing. A guard made this worse: it demanded a fact that no tool could supply, so the loop did not end. One catering scout ran seven consecutive searches for a single drive time, spent its full 25-search budget, and recorded one vendor. No error occurred. Also, every surface counted the requested calls, not the performed calls, so a scout with a cap of 25 could report 30 searches.
story.solution: A durable per-session counter lives in agent/lib/search-budget.ts: 25 queries for a scout, 40 for the root agent, and the tool derives the tier from ctx.session.parent. The unit is the query, not the tool call, so a four-query batch cannot quadruple the budget. A call that cannot reach the provider returns before the counter moves. The tool counts the batch one time, so a retried transient failure does not pay twice. Exhaustion returns status cap_reached with an instruction to finish from the found results. The taxonomy in agent/lib/actions.ts classes cap_reached as a refusal, so toolRuns() reports the performed searches, not the requested searches.
story.outcome: The fix moved the guard to a fact that the tools can reach. The vendor's town stays required, the drive note is optional, and the scout never searches for one. Two npm run eval:scout runs over the same brief read 33/37 and 52/53 = 98%, with the radius judge at 100% in all five categories. scripts/test-trace-fold.mjs asserts that a refused search is not a search, and scripts/test-outcomes.mjs fails when any tool status loses its classification. The radius later moved into record_vendor as straight-line distance, which the tool measures and does not search. Thus the fix for the endless loop and the hard limit no longer depend on the same sentence of prose.

prerequisites: An eve install with defineState and declared subagents (^0.24.4)
NEBIUS_API_KEY for a Token Factory model
TAVILY_API_KEY for live web search (the two checks in the recipe run without it)
The Delegation recipe's declared specialist — the cap is per agent because the session is per agent

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Nothing to configure for the two checks below. For the live agent, put NEBIUS_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY in .env.local (full list in README.md).
quickstart.run: npm run test:fold && npm run test:outcomes
